title: Checkpoint: runs count once
prompt: Upgrade the broken `compress`: sum elements, but each RUN of equal adjacent elements counts once ({2,2,5,5,5,1} → 8). The broken version sums every element (15). Compare each element with its predecessor — one extra condition in the loop body is enough.

tests.name: runs counted once
tests.hint: Add arr[i] only when i == 0 or arr[i] != arr[i-1] — the run's first element represents it.
